title: Peacock feather
prompt: A single, elegant peacock weather, with wispy barbs and of course that signature, iridescent eye pattern. Have it curve ever so slightly to the left. I’d like it to be done in an illustrated style as though it is done in fine line color pencils

responses.notes: Generated via clean-context subagent; standard technical appendix v1 appended to the prompt. Ink-bounds check passed — worst dead margin 1.4%. The only response to declare a role and aria-label on the root. Builds the eye as five nested gradient-filled ovals (outer halo, gold, copper, blue, indigo pupil) with a separate barb-stroke layer fanning out from a single origin point at the eye's base, so the barbs radiate from the eye rather than from the shaft. Rachis is a filled tapering polygon plus three offset stroke copies for pencil pressure; two blurred radial ellipses sit on top as a specular sheen. A large blurred silhouette of the whole feather underlies everything at 17% opacity as a soft shadow.
